extraction_warnings.message: The 2025-08-27 10-Q DOCX contains only the message "This format is in the process of being created from the filing. Please check back shortly." No facts were extracted from that file. Comparable Q2 FY2026 quarter data were instead taken from later provided filings where directly disclosed.

Standalone Q4 FY2025 and Q4 FY2026 quarter values are not directly disclosed in the provided documents used here and were not derived by subtracting year-to-date amounts from full-year amounts because calculations are prohibited.

For April 26, 2026 and July 26, 2026, current marketable investments are presented separately as marketable debt securities and marketable equity securities. No combined short_term_investments amount was calculated; the two reported components are preserved as separate other metrics.

The cash-flow line used as capex is reported as "Purchases related to property and equipment and intangible assets"; it is mapped to capex with requires_review=true because the source line includes intangible assets.
The supplied Form 4 beneficial-ownership filings do not map to the requested financial canonical metrics, so they are listed in documents but do not generate financial facts.

The earnings-release webpage https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027 could not be fetched: outbound access to nvidianews.nvidia.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy (CONNECT tunnel rejected, HTTP 403 from the proxy gateway; not a transient network error). Only the user-uploaded investor-presentation PDF was processed; the formal earnings press-release text was not extracted.

This presentation states only fiscal labels ("Q2 FY26"/"Q2 FY27"/"Q3 FY27") and a cover-page month ("August 2026"); it does not print exact period_start/period_end calendar dates anywhere in the document. All facts from this document therefore carry period_end=null even though the Q2 FY27 calendar quarter-end (2026-07-26) is already established elsewhere in this run's corpus (the 10-Q). Join by fiscal_year/fiscal_quarter if an exact date is needed downstream.

Document-level filing_date (2026-08-26) is taken from the PDF's embedded CreationDate metadata (Microsoft PowerPoint export), not from printed text in the document body. It is corroborated by the cover slide's "August 2026" label and matches this run's existing Q2 FY27 10-Q filing date, but is technically inferred from file metadata rather than a printed filing date.

Capital-return totals (Q2 FY27 $26.0B, Q2 FY26 $10.0B) could not be split into dividends vs. share repurchases: the source is a stacked-bar chart rendered as vector graphics, and pdftotext's text layer does not expose the individual segment values. The precise split is already available from the 10-Q in sources/financials/normalized_financials.json.

Nine facts in this document are Q3 FY27 forward-looking guidance figures (revenue, gross margin %, operating expenses, and non-GAAP tax rate range), not actual reported results for a completed period. Each is marked requires_review=true for this reason.

This presentation does not disclose a balance sheet, R&D/S&M/G&A expense breakdown, share repurchase/dividend dollar amounts individually, debt, commitments, or segment data for Gaming, Professional Visualization, Automotive, or OEM & Other; it is a Data-Center-focused investor deck. No values were invented for these; they remain absent from this extraction.

Non-GAAP definitional change and retroactive restatement disclosed in NVDA-F2Q27-Quarterly-Presentation-final-1.pdf (p.14): "Beginning in Q1 FY27, NVIDIA's non-GAAP financial measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation expense. The historical non-GAAP financial information presented has been updated to include stock-based compensation expense." This disclosure was absent from the initial extraction of that document. As a result, the Q2 FY2026 non-GAAP facts sourced from it are restated presentations rather than as-originally-reported figures; they are now marked is_restated=true (18 facts). The Q2 FY27 non-GAAP year-over-year change figures (5 facts) are computed by the company against that restated base and are flagged accordingly. GAAP figures for the same periods are unaffected. NVIDIA's originally reported (pre-restatement) Q2 FY2026 non-GAAP figures are not present in this corpus, so the restatement delta could not be verified against a primary source. See also adjustment candidate ADJ-014.

FY27 세율 가이던스의 적용 범위 차이: 투자자 프레젠테이션은 non-GAAP만 명시하고 SEC CFO Commentary는 GAAP·non-GAAP 모두에 적용한다고 기술한다. 수치(16.0~18.0%)는 동일하므로 값 충돌이 아니라 범위 차이이며, GAAP 범위를 DOC-019 출처로 FACT-0199, FACT-0200에 별도 기록했다. www.sec.gov가 이 환경의 egress 정책상 차단되어 문서 본문을 직접 열람하지 못했다. 서로 다른 검색 질의 2회가 동일 문구를 반환했으나 원문 대조는 아니다. Tier 1 문서이되 취득 경로는 검색 요약이다.
